One resident reported hearing gunmen firing at his neighbor's house, meters away, while his wife and children were inside, trembling with fear. The market is developing rapidly due to threats in the Strait of Hormuz and naval fleets in Europe.

headlines.title: "בן 99, מרגיש כמו 50": הסוד של ה"אבא" של מטוס הקרב הישראלי הראשון
headlines.snippet: Approaching 100 years old, Ben-Ami Gov, considered the 'father' of Israel's first fighter jet, feels like he's 50. He recalls carrying children who died in his arms during the War of Independence and building aircraft from scratch. Gov joined convoys to besieged Jerusalem, was drafted into the Palmach without anyone knowing, and became an engineer who circumvented the French embargo to build the Kfir jet. In an interview for an honorary doctorate from the Technion, he explained his youthful feeling and his views on Israel's reliance on American weaponry.
